error[ZBX-E0223]: the working directory is not in the container
  while  running a command in the container web-1
  cause  entering the working directory failed: no such file or directory
         (ENOENT)
  cause  the container has no directory /nowhere to start the command in
  dir    /nowhere
  name   web-1
  pid    502
  step   enter_workdir (23 of 31)
  fix    make it first:   zbx exec web-1 -- mkdir -p /nowhere
         or name one the container has: --workdir /
  more   zbx explain E0223
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0223.html
